description: The full AgentTwin loop in one call (same as `npx agenttwin`): pick a workflow, generate twins and test data, run your real code on them, inject the standard faults (lost reply, 500, slow reply, duplicate delivery), report each failure with its money or data impact and source line, and propose a code fix. Applies the fix and proves it on the same faults only when applyFix is true. Returns findings, the fix diff and next steps.
name: find_and_fix
